segments.text: It's now time to turn to our very special guest this afternoon, Mrs. Gina White, who
is here to talk to us about how she turned her health around, and is now about to run
seven marathons in seven days. I must say, the thought of it makes me feel faint. How
How did it all start, Gina?
Well, good afternoon, Peter.
I suppose it all started when I just got thoroughly fed up with feeling ill all the time.
I was only in my late thirties, but was already having difficulty in climbing up stairs and
doing things like the gardening.
I would get so breathless.
But when I started to have constant chest infections and aches and pains, I went to
the doctor and she said I was clinically obese and putting too much strain on my
heart. I was very shocked. I knew I was a bit overweight but obese was not a word
I liked and I was really worried when the doctor told me about my heart. I
decided there and then to do something about it. So how did you go about it?
Well, I tried dieting at first, you know, to lose the excess weight, but I found it
very hard to stick to a diet. It's all very well if you have plenty of time to
focus on yourself, but when you have to cook for a family every day, it's so much
easier to eat the same as they do. You'd think that running around after the
family would keep us in trim, wouldn't you? I know, but it doesn't seem to work
like that. I suppose I used to snack a lot, on chocolate and sweet things, to give me
some energy. And that wasn't very good for my health.
